summary: Retest of the iteration-37 Home Command Center fixes (Phase 2 Chunk 2D) on the preview URL only, never production. I ran the API checks in backend/tests/home_retest_iter38.py plus home_drill_tie_smoke.py for admin and sales. I ran the UI checks with Playwright as admin (Customize, drill links) and as sales (inventory chip and flat-cell drills). All 8 retest items pass. Customize Save -> immediate reload keeps the saved layout, in the API and the UI. Reset restores the defaults straight away. Holds expiring 1 -> /flats?hold_expiring=1 lists 1 flat (C-204). Tower B 'Hold 2' -> /flats?block_id&status=Hold lists 2. Clicking a flat cell -> /flats?block_id&status=Hold lists 2. Construction and milestone links open /construction with the right project and tower already selected (SGH Tower B, 55%). Pipeline for this month: Leads 7=7, Lost 2=2, Visits 0=0, Bookings 0=0. Pipeline for FY, checked through the API: Leads 50=50, Visits 24=24, Bookings 24=24, Lost 6=6. Follow-ups due 1=1. Ageing links are now /reports/outstanding-v2?bucket=<band>, with no x=1. For sales, each inventory row total equals the sum of the masked counts (Tower B 13+2+17=32), so no real Booked/Blocked split leaks. Sold 17 -> list of 17. Switching on a hidden widget shows the widget-inflow_30-pending placeholder, not a skeleton. Drill ties: admin 41/42 (the 1 miss is the Bounced 0-count case the brief accepts), sales 15/15.

minor.issue: drill.pick 'Bounced.count' returns None when there are 0 bounced cheques. The brief accepts this; listed only for completeness.

integration_issues.issue: Reports.jsx ignores the bucket param, and the report API is called without a bucket filter. The report shows the full ₹7.43 Cr list instead of the ₹49.9 L / 10-booking band, so the band figure does not equal the list total. The link format fix (no x=1) passes; band filtering is still missing.

design_issues.screen: /flats and /leads?tab=list opened from a drill link
issues: Filters that come from the URL (block_id, hold_expiring, created_from/created_to, due_today) are not shown as chips. There is no visible block filter and no 'clear filter' control, so a user can't tell why the list is short or how to reset it. Example: the /flats?hold_expiring=1 status dropdown says 'All statuses' while only 1 flat is listed.
None of the status chips (All/Active/Completed/Cancelled) is highlighted for the combined status, so the filter state is unclear.
Still shows 'No bookings to bill' for SGH Tower A, which has 20 active bookings (iteration-37 action item, not in this retest scope).

action_items: Optional: make the ageing band drill filter by band. Reports.jsx should read sp.get('bucket') and pass it to /reports/outstanding-v2, and the report should filter or highlight that band so the band total equals the figure.
Optional UX: show URL drill filters as removable chips on Flats, Leads and Bookings (block, hold expiring, created range, due today, multi-status).
Optional: change the 'No bookings to bill' text when active_bookings > 0 (carried over from iteration 37).
critical_code_review_comments: home_layout.py PUT/DELETE now call ttlcache.invalidate(f'home:bundle:{user_id}:'), which is correct and verified.

Home.jsx pending check is `data && !loading && !st`. It works, but it relies on the bundle omitting widgets that are hidden in the layout. If a widget is ever truly missing because of a backend bug, it would show 'Save your layout' instead of an error.
Bookings.jsx passes the comma-separated status through unchanged. The backend accepts it (the FY tie of 24 matched).

success_rate.backend: 100% of retest items (8/8); drill ties admin 41/42 (accepted Bounced 0-case), sales 15/15
success_rate.frontend: 100% of retest items; 1 minor gap (ageing band list not filtered)
